# Stock Analyza

> Independent stock research and valuation. Each analysis values a company in bear, base and bull scenarios, applies a required margin of safety and ends with a clear verdict (BUY, HOLD or SELL) and a maximum buy price. Free analyses are published on stockanalyza.com. Premium analyses are on Patreon. Nothing here is investment advice.

Every analysis follows the same framework: the company is routed to a sector-specific model, valued with a primary and a secondary method, triangulated into Bear, Base and Bull Values, discounted by a margin of safety that reflects forecast confidence, and checked by an adversarial review before the verdict is final. Scores: Business Quality (0 to 100), Valuation (0 to 100), Confidence (0 to 25 with a letter grade).

Prices and values in each analysis are as of its publication date. Always cite the date when quoting a verdict or a value.

## Analyses

- [Ouster (OUST), September 25, 2026](https://stockanalyza.com/analysis/oust/index.md): Digital lidar and perception company for physical AI, growing over 50% but still unprofitable, valued on forward EV to revenue after cash burn and a normalized profitability model; the price sits above even the Bull value. Bear $15.78, Base $25.28, Bull $40.80. Verdict REDUCE at $41.37, maximum buy price $12.64.
- [Cognex (CGNX), September 25, 2026](https://stockanalyza.com/analysis/cgnx/index.md): Industrial machine vision leader in a strong cyclical recovery, acquiring RealSense for robotic perception, valued on normalized EV to EBITDA and free cash flow after stock compensation; the price implies Bull-case EBITDA. Bear $35.03, Base $45.90, Bull $65.76. Verdict HOLD at $57.70 (watchlist for new money), maximum buy price $29.84.
- [Symbotic (SYM), September 25, 2026](https://stockanalyza.com/analysis/sym/index.md): AI-enabled warehouse automation company with $22.5 billion of backlog, about 87% customer concentration and an Up-C structure of about 605 million economic shares, valued on forward EV to revenue and EBITDA after stock compensation. Bear $23.44, Base $31.30, Bull $52.02. Verdict HOLD at $44.04 (do not add), maximum buy price $15.65.
- [Intuitive Surgical (ISRG), September 25, 2026](https://stockanalyza.com/analysis/isrg/index.md): da Vinci surgical robot maker with 84% recurring revenue, valued as a compounder with a 10-year two-stage DCF on free cash flow after stock compensation; the price implies about 19% annual cash flow growth.
